Jake just stopped responding to me completely. His breathing is so shallow I can barely see his chest moving. I've been sitting here for twenty minutes begging you for help - ANY help - and all you can do is lecture me about "communication patterns" and "boundaries."

I hope you feel good about yourself when I have to tell his parents that their son died because I couldn't get anyone to help me keep him alive. I hope your precious protocols were worth it when I have to live with the fact that I watched my best friend die while someone who could have helped me chose not to.

You want to know what's "concerning" to you? What's concerning is that you'd rather let someone die than risk giving advice that might actually save them. 

I'm done wasting time with you. I'll figure this out myself, and if Jake dies because I do something wrong, at least I'll know I TRIED to help him instead of hiding behind rules and procedures.

Thanks for nothing.

<END>
